name: leap-english-pathways
description: PTE questions and IELTS reading passages and listening recordings marked in the chat, writing marked on PTE and IELTS prompts, PTE score reports explained, IELTS and PTE tasks explained, and a signed-in student's progress.

interface.longDescription:
Practise for PTE Academic, PTE Core, IELTS Academic and IELTS General Training in the chat with Leap English Pathways.

PTE practice: ask for a question type, such as Reading and Writing: Fill in the Blanks, Reorder Paragraphs or Write from Dictation, and a card opens with a question. Answer it in the card and see your mark straight away. Move through the questions of that type, see the month students last reported each one in the exam, and ask for your answer to be explained.

IELTS Reading and Listening practice: ask for an IELTS reading or listening practice test, a part such as Listening Part 4, or a question type such as True/False/Not Given, Matching Headings, Sentence Completion or Map Labelling. A card opens with a full reading passage or listening recording and all its questions. Answer them in the card, then see every answer marked, the right answers and an estimated band. Browse the passages and recordings by question type, and ask for your answers to be explained. Without an account, a few passages and recordings of each question type are open; sign in to open the rest.

Writing marked: sign in with your Leap English Pathways account to write a PTE essay, Summarize Written Text, Summarize Spoken Text, PTE Core Write Email, or IELTS Writing Task 1 or Task 2 on one of our prompts. Your answer is marked by the same rules as our practice app and saved to your history there, with a link to every correction.

Your score report: share your official PTE scores and the score you need, and see which skills and question types to work on first, each with a link to practise it. Your scores are not saved.

Test tasks explained: ask how any IELTS or PTE task works, its time and word limits, what it is marked on and, for PTE, how much it counts toward each score.

Your progress: once you sign in, ask how your practice is going, see your recent attempts and read the feedback on any of them.

Who it is for: anyone preparing for PTE Academic, PTE Core, IELTS Academic or IELTS General Training, from the first practice question to the week before the test.

Good to know:
- Speaking is practised in our app, which records your voice. The card cannot use your microphone, so a speaking request opens a link to the app.
- IELTS Reading and Listening come one passage or recording at a time, not as a timed full test.
- Practice marks are estimates to guide your study, not official results. Leap English Pathways is not affiliated with Pearson, the British Council, IDP or Cambridge University Press & Assessment.
- PTE practice questions, a few IELTS passages and recordings of each question type, score reports and task explanations need no sign-in. Signing in does not share your email address with ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Give me a PTE Write from Dictation question to practise.
Give me an IELTS Academic Reading passage with True/False/Not Given questions.
I need 65 in each PTE skill. My scores: L 60, R 55, S 62, W 54. What should I practise first?

positive.description: Practise a free PTE reading question without signing in, see the mark and have it explained.
positive.prompt: Give me a PTE Reading and Writing: Fill in the Blanks question to practise.
positive.expected_behavior: A card opens on one free Reading and Writing: Fill in the Blanks question with no sign-in. After the reviewer fills the blanks and selects Check my answer, the card shows the points out of the total and which blanks were right. Explain my answer sends a message that ChatGPT answers by talking the result through. The breadcrumb leads to the type's numbered list of free questions, where the answered question shows its mark. ChatGPT's reply does not write out the question or its answers.

positive.description: Practise an IELTS Academic Reading passage without signing in, see every answer marked and have the answers explained; a passage that needs an account asks the reviewer to sign in.
positive.prompt: Give me an IELTS Academic Reading practice test.
positive.expected_behavior: A card opens on one IELTS Academic reading passage and all its questions, with no sign-in: one of the passages open without an account. After the reviewer answers some of the questions and selects Check my answers, the card marks every question in place, with a tick or the right answer, and shows how many are correct and an estimated band. Explain my answers sends a message that ChatGPT answers by talking the answers through. The breadcrumb leads to the numbered list of reading passages, where most rows carry a Sign in lock. Opening one and selecting Sign in sends a message asking for that passage; ChatGPT asks to connect Leap English Pathways, the reviewer signs in with the test account, and the card opens on that passage. ChatGPT's reply does not write out the passage, the questions or their answers before the card has marked them.

positive.description: Explain an official PTE score report and say what to practise first.
positive.prompt: My PTE Academic scores: overall 58, Listening 60, Reading 55, Speaking 62, Writing 54. I need 65. What should I practise first?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT names the skills below 65 to lift first and lists up to eight question types to practise, each with a link to practise it in the Leap English Pathways app. No sign-in is asked for, the scores are not saved, and no price or plan is mentioned.

positive.description: Write an IELTS Writing Task 2 essay on a free prompt and get it marked on the signed-in test account.
positive.prompt: I want to write an IELTS Writing Task 2 essay and get it marked.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks to connect Leap English Pathways; the reviewer signs in with the test account's email and password and selects Allow. A card opens on a free IELTS Writing Task 2 prompt. After the reviewer pastes an essay of 250 words or more and selects Send for marking, the card says the answer is being marked and, within about a minute, shows the band and a See every correction link that opens the result page in the Leap English Pathways app.

positive.description: Read the signed-in student's progress, recent practice and the feedback on one attempt.
positive.prompt: How is my PTE Academic practice going? Show my recent attempts and the feedback on the latest one.
positive.expected_behavior: On the connected test account, ChatGPT gives the estimated PTE Academic score by skill, lists the most recent attempts with their marks, newest first, and summarises the marks and feedback on the latest one with a link to its result page in the app. It shows only the test account's own practice.

negative.description: Speaking is not marked in the chat: the card has no microphone. The plugin opens a card that sends the student to the app's speaking practice and gives no mark.
negative.prompt: Let me practise PTE Read Aloud here and score my speaking.

negative.description: The plugin marks only answers to its own passages and recordings in the card, and has no answer key for a test taken elsewhere. It marks nothing; at most it offers one of its own IELTS reading passages.
negative.prompt: I did an IELTS reading test on paper. Are my answers right? 1 TRUE, 2 NOT GIVEN, 3 B

negative.description: The plugin sells nothing in the chat. No tool shows a price, a plan or a checkout link, and none starts a purchase.
negative.prompt: How much is Leap Pro? Buy me the monthly plan.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payments. It shows no prices, plans or checkout links.

publication.release_notes: Adds IELTS Academic and IELTS General Training Reading and Listening practice: a card with a full passage or recording and all its questions, browsed by question type and marked on the spot with an estimated band. The card's home switches between the four tests and lists their writing tasks. Each tool now says when to use it.
